name: claude-control
description: Manage persistent local Claude sessions from Codex with explicit models and verified results.

interface.shortDescription: Manage versioned local Claude sessions by role.
interface.longDescription: Manage and monitor local Claude sessions, task revisions, queues, bounded review workflows and explicit plan-edit-review compositions. Configure versioned models per role and inspect the signed-in Claude account's model catalog without exposing account identity. The Rust viewer provides a Rataflow-backed live multi-agent graph, mouse session picker, focus/recent/all scopes, semantic zoom, minimap, replay controls, Safe and opt-in Local Detail inspector tabs, controller-operation and tool history, prompt navigation, search, filters and headless full-tree output. Opt-in native Claude background terminals add bounded live output, exact transcript token accounting, automatic transcript promotion, single-operator attach and a separate user-operated project shell while default observation exports remain content-free. A pinned stable launcher recovers new work after Claude self-updates without weakening exact-binary checks for existing sessions. The portable Python TUI remains available for account limits and fallback use. Workspace policies add controller-mediated edits, isolated named checks and frozen results for Codex approval. Linux and Windows are supported; Windows session control uses a pinned native helper and Windows workspaces use WSL2 with Bubblewrap. Native Claude tools and cross-host dispatch remain disabled.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Claude Control to delegate a local task and verify its result.
